profile.summary: • Experienced mobile tools engineer - CICD, build environment

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Build, manage, support Jenkins CICD pipeline and tools for Pandora mobile apps family
Manage, deploy MacOS build infrastructure with Anka
positions.insights: Skills: Swift (Programming Language) · Jenkins · anka · Fastlane

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
iOS release automation
• Implemented and automated iOS release pipeline with fastlane, Github, CircleCI
• prototyped accessibility test, snapshot test to CI
iOS automation with XCUI
• Implemented XCUI test framework for ende to end test and mock http server in Swift
• Developed and maintained UI tests for features and regression test
iOS development with UIKit
• Implemented Handshake virtual career fair view in UIKit

positions.title: Software Development Engineer In Test
positions.description:
iOS automation with Appium framework
• Developed and maintained BDD automation test framework in Java, Cucumber, Groovy, Gherkin for iOS, Android and backend API testing
• Implemented and developed new automation test framework in Java to improve stability and shorten test run time by 200%
• Setup real device and emulators lab for CI/CD incorporated with Jenkins, Phabricator and Amazon SQS
• Prototyped XCUItest for Grindr iOS app with swift/wiremock

positions.title: Software Engineer II in Test
positions.description:
Android automation with Appium framework
• Developed and executed automation tests for Tagged Android mobile applications using Java, Appium, TestNG, Jenkins, Job-DSL
• Developed and maintained internal API framework using Retrofit2 to support QA tools and core functionalities 
• Developed scripts to manage and maintain Selenium GRID of emulators
• Developed scripts to monitor and manage healthiness of  real devices lab

positions.title: Senior Member of the Technical Staff
positions.description:
Oracle Cloud PaaS SaaS Lifecycle Testing
• Perform system testing of PaaS SaaS lifecycle projects on Oracle Cloud covering OTBI/OTBI-E, ABCS, CPQ from product inception to launch
Oracle Cloud PaaS SaaS UI Integration Testing
•  Design and perform functional and regression tests for Oracle PaaS and SaaS end to end flow covering REST calls, OAuth and SHA2.
•  Develop automation utilizing Selenium wrapper and NGTT framework

Fusion Applications SaaS Production Cloning
• Perform system testing for cloning based migration of fusion applications, identity management data (LDAP users/groups and app roles), configurations and customizations, and transactional data from production to stage enviorment
• Analyze requirements and  certify procedures for cloning framework on customized fusion application pods including SSL enabled communication for backend services and databases in deployments, Multi-Tenancy support, and Advanced Data Security enabled database (Transparent Data Encryption & Database Vault)
• Develop automation for cloning procedures as well as validation cases (Python, Perl, Shell Script)

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff
positions.description:
Oracle Cloud PaaS DB Service Testing
• Designed and performed functional, capacity, failover and compliance test cases for Cloud DB Service end to end flow covering APEX, Oracle Fusion middleware technologies like WebLogic, OAM, IDM, SOA, and Oracle eBusiness Suite.
• Designed, implemented, and executed end to end test cases to migrate data from local database to Oracle Cloud DB service with SQL Developer
• Developed system setup automation for Oracle Cloud UI and APEX DB services( Python, Perl, Shell Script)

positions.title: Technology Analyst
positions.description:
Goldman Electronic Market, QA, Agile testing
• Designed and performed functional, capacity, failover and compliance test cases based on the business requirement as well as SEC regulations. 
• Developed automation end to end tests for GEM using python, sql language.
• Performed user acceptance tests, compliance tests and generated daily reports 
• Tested market data feed, open/close market and data stream servers. 

Smart Routing & Rule Engine, QA
• Designed and performed functional end-to-end test based on the business requirement for new releases.

Algorithm Trading Engine, QA
• Performed functional and regression end-to-end tests on new release
